name: elf-locks

attributes.attribute: folkloric motif of tangled hair after a fairy visit
left human hair tangled after a romantic dream
named for the elves or fairies who made the knots

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Elf-locks is a folkloric motif. When a fairy visited a sleeping human, the sleeper dreamed of a blissful romantic meeting. On waking, the dreamer found the hair hopelessly tangled. The knots defied every comb. Such mischief occurred when fairies and humans met, in sleep or in waking life.
